content: Interaction patterns for the application of the sender- receiver paradigm The possible interaction patterns for the application of the sender- receiver paradigm are explained, namely: 1. Data-access in a cat. 1 RunnableEntity , 2. explicit sending, 3. the DataSendCompletedEvent : dealing with the success/failure of an explicit send, and 4. the DataReceivedEvent : responding to the reception of data 5. the DataReceiveErrorEvent : notifying an error concerning the reception of data.
